After the triple gate has ended and its host record is settled, spawn fresh Codex gpt-6.1-sol worker delegations for the next disjoint prepared TermAl implementation packages. Do not spawn them during the current gate or alter its roots. Keep existing assigned owners working; report the concrete Sol sessions and claims once admitted.'

- Sol-1 gets w-a7bbdea31231 (the cargo target<random> sibling fence).
- Sol-2 gets w-03d466958d59 (the launcher fingerprint must not depend on line endings).
- Criteria for both are worded by me as non-completer (02:40Z).
- Existing owners: Termal::Codex (8582) has w-1bf3d434a624; CSharpProof has w-f8f8e04dffbb; Opus3 has w-66d5 (diagnosis).
Tests only in coordinator-granted filtered slots; then freeze, review pair, and offer to Termal::Merger.
